verdict.rationale: The California EDD is a government online-services provider, not an agent, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only human-facing e-Services portal functions. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal returned 403 to an agent, so there is no evidence of any MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
